isn't the same case for some signals that are already in the codebase ?
```symbol_hovered```  
```code_completion_requested```  

From the conversations I had with @kitbdev, I understood that ```script_text_editor``` is not the only class that should use the ```code_edit``` functionalities.

What kind of dangers do you see when exposing this signal ?

The "danger" is having one more piece of public API to maintain.
If this signal is deemed obsolete it cannot be easily removed. If it were to require more parameters, it cannot be changed because that would break compatibility, and there's no way to handle it without adding a whole other signal.

Once again, unfortunately, there's no way to prevent signals from being exposed. Maybe https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105691 at least discourages their use, but it's a partial solution.

Related discussion: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/69012#discussion_r2051736104 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102380#discussion_r2060648952
